description: Phase 0+1: Repository hygiene and critical auth/payment fixes. Covers findings C-1, L-1, C-5, M-16, C-2, C-3, C-4, H-1.
steps: Replace .gitignore with comprehensive ignore rules covering .env files, Python caches, node_modules, IDE files, Docker overrides, and .canvas/ directory. Keep .env.example and .env.shared un-ignored.
Remove .env and apps/backend/.env from git tracking using 'git rm --cached' commands.

In apps/backend/app/config.py: Add a @model_validator(mode='after') method 'validate_production_secrets' inside the Settings class that (a) raises ValueError if JWT_SECRET is the default in production, (b) raises ValueError if JWT_SECRET < 32 chars in production, (c) logs warnings for missing MONGODB_URI, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL, AZURE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT in production. Also remove 'http://localhost:5173' from the default ALLOWED_ORIGINS value (M-14) and add logic to allowed_origins_list property to filter localhost in production.

In apps/backend/app/api/v1/subscription.py: Add 'from fastapi import Depends' and 'from app.api.v1.auth import get_current_user' imports. Change all 'user: User = None' to 'user: User = Depends(get_current_user)'. Remove all 'if not user' guards. Change error detail in exceptions from f-string with str(e) to generic messages.

In apps/backend/app/api/v1/users.py: Add 'from fastapi import Depends' and 'from app.api.v1.auth import get_current_user' and 'from typing import Optional' imports. Change all 'user: User = None' to 'user: User = Depends(get_current_user)'. Create UpdateProfileRequest(BaseModel) with optional name and preferred_language fields. Change PUT /me to accept body: UpdateProfileRequest instead of query params. Remove all 'if not user' guards.

In apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py: Fix hmac.new() to hmac.HMAC(key=..., msg=..., digestmod=...). Replace raw PyMongo db.users.find_one/update_one calls with Beanie User model: 'from app.models.user import User', use 'await User.find_one({...})' and 'await user.update({...})'. Remove get_mongo_client imports.

In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py: Add RefreshTokenRequest(BaseModel) with refresh_token field. Change refresh_token_endpoint to accept 'body: RefreshTokenRequest' parameter and use body.refresh_token instead of bare string parameter (M-7).
In apps/backend/app/main.py lifespan: Add a warning log after init_mongo/init_redis if JWT_SECRET equals the default value (H-1 additional hardening).
acceptance_criteria: .gitignore contains rules for .env, __pycache__/, node_modules/, .venv/, IDE files, and .canvas/
.env and apps/backend/.env are removed from git tracking
config.py has validate_production_secrets model_validator that raises for default JWT_SECRET in production
subscription.py uses Depends(get_current_user) on all endpoints
users.py uses Depends(get_current_user) and UpdateProfileRequest body model
razorpay.py uses hmac.HMAC and Beanie User model instead of raw PyMongo
auth.py refresh endpoint accepts token in request body via RefreshTokenRequest model
All modified Python files pass py_compile syntax check
verification: git ls-files | grep '\.env$' should return empty
findings: pyenv needed global set (pyenv global 3.11.15) for python command. Also removed all __pycache__ and .canvas/ files from git tracking since .gitignore now excludes them.
